source: V20 Dark Ages (VtDA20), The Roads We Walk, pp. 110–145, and Appendix B, Apocrypha of the Clans, pp. 432–449 (the Road of Blood, the Road of the Abyss, the Road of Paradox, the Code of Samiel, the Road of Set and the Path of Apep). The Road of Night is from the Dark Ages Storytellers Companion (2002) pp. 28-30. Sins are WoDX paraphrases; the book's rationales are not reproduced.

aura.note: Road 10: −2 difficulty … Road 1: +2 (aura modifiers apply to Social rolls with humans).

beast.name: Road of the Beast
sins: Putting your own existence at risk
Acting with no gain to you
Not killing when it is you or them

sinsAt.8: Ignoring a threat to your hunt

sinsAt.2: Accepting ties to a land or people

sinsAt.6: Finding comfort in a city rather than wrecking it

heaven.name: Road of Heaven
heaven.note: No base hierarchy: each faith's Path has its own (pp. 120–121, 137–138).

paths.name: Path of Christ
sins: Acting from pride, greed or lust
Lying under oath or about others
Feeding on an innocent without leave

paths.name: Derech Chaim (Path of Life)
sins: Needless dealings with outsiders to the faith
No rabbinical authority, or ignoring its rulings
Breaking the community's laws and customs
Cutting ties with a local community of the faith

paths.name: Path of the Prophet
sins: Not submitting to the divine will

paths.name: Path of the Eightfold Wheel
sins: No time alone in wild silence

paths.name: Path of the Watchful Gods
sins: Violence that offends gods or spirits

paths.name: Path of the Pure
paths.house: The Katharoi's Path of the Road of Heaven, with its aura, Virtues and ethics (V20 Dark Ages pp. 119-120)
sins: Desiring a material thing or a person
Feeding past half the blood pool
Telling a lie or tricking someone
Taking authority or honours, except as the Path's teacher
Lust, or drinking another Cainite's blood
Torturing or ravaging for pleasure or power

paths.name: Path of the Archangel
paths.auraOn: when the follower's loss and longing, or being seen as a martyr, would move others
paths.house: A Path of the Road of Heaven with the Road's Virtues; the Nephilim's harder sin rolls are their bloodline's weakness, not the Path's (p. 70)
sins: Turning away someone who needs inspiration
Giving in to the Beast, as in frenzy

sinsAt.10: Thinking or acting as a vampire

sinsAt.7: Damaging common property, even by accident
sinsAt.1: Ending a community's power to grow

sinsAt.7: Keeping a Cainite from the journey you began

paths.name: Road of Ahura Mazda
paths.auraOn: in a frenzy, two Willpower points name one thing the vampire will not do
paths.house: The second Road of Zarathustra: the Road of Humanity's chart with three sins added, and Conviction and Self-Control

sinsAt.8: Speaking evil, or ill of others

kings.name: Road of Kings
sins: Treating an inferior as an equal
Letting a challenge to your honour pass

paths.name: Path of Chivalry
sins: Neglecting your duty for any reason
Letting a challenge to your honour pass

paths.name: Path of Devaraja
sins: Treating an inferior as an equal
Letting a chance at power pass
Letting a challenge to your honour pass

paths.name: Path of Daena
sins: Neglecting your duty for any reason

lilith.name: Road of Lilith
sins: Joining a system built by the unwise
Passing off another's learning as yours
Standing between someone and a hard lesson

sinsAt.5: Taking a student the first time they ask
sinsAt.2: Putting another's learning before your own

sinsAt.9: Abiding by any law of Caine or God
sinsAt.8: Leaving the works of Noddist liars standing
sinsAt.4: Snuffing out one who wants to burn brighter

sinsAt.10: Turning away demons who bring seed
sinsAt.7: Abandoning a creation for being ugly or frightening
sinsAt.5: Leaving a secret of making with those who miss its purpose
sinsAt.1: Turning away angels who bring seed

metamorphosis.name: Road of Metamorphosis
sins: Letting pleasure or feeling distract you
Not experimenting out of pity or disgust

sin.name: Road of Sin
sins: Not riding the wave of frenzy
Not acting against those who would bind you
Not feeding or killing when needed

paths.name: Path of Pleasure
sins: Not riding the wave of frenzy
Not feeding or killing when needed

paths.name: Path of the Devil
sins: Acknowledging the laws of God or man
Not riding the wave of frenzy
Not acting against those who bind you
Not feeding or killing when needed

paths.name: Path of Screams
sins: Not riding the wave of frenzy
Not feeding or killing when needed

bones.name: Road of Bones
sins: Withholding knowledge from a worthy seeker
Seeking power, status or mortal ties
Destroying knowledge that can't be replaced

yasa.name: Road of Yasa
sins: Insulting someone who didn't earn it
Mercy to one who hasn't yielded
Hurting kin, herd or allies in frenzy

blood.name: Road of Blood
sins: Letting feeling steer what you do
Leaving an unworthy vampire's blood undrunk
Bowing to an unworthy prince or elder
Being blood bound to another Cainite

abyss.name: Road of the Abyss
abyss.house: V20 Dark Ages p. 442 gives only the hierarchy; the aura and Virtues are those of the Road of Sin (p. 133), a house reading
sins: Missing a chance to watch the darkness show itself
Not killing when killing is quickest
Keeping knowledge from another Abyss mystic
Letting morals get in the way of studying the Abyss
Turning from the Abyss in aversion

paradox.name: Road of Paradox
sins: Refusing to accept death when it comes
Not killing vampires who walk other Roads
Putting your own affairs before your svadharma
Not helping another toward their svadharma
Killing a mortal for anything but survival
Embracing out of your own desire

samiel.name: Code of Samiel
samiel.house: V20 Dark Ages pp. 447-448 give the hierarchy and Virtues; the aura is the Road of Heaven's (p. 119), whose Christian ideals the Code grew into, a house reading
sins: Feeding on the innocent without their leave
Not defending or helping someone in need
Not defending or helping a Healer in need
Not challenging a vampire low on their Road
Passing up a chance for vengeance
Helping demons, Baali, Setites or other evils

set.name: Road of Set
set.house: V20 Dark Ages p. 449 gives the hierarchies only; the Virtues are those of V20's Path of Typhon (p. 339), the Road's later form, and the aura is the Road of Heaven's, another Road of worship (p. 119), a house reading
sins: Putting your own pleasure before the Road
Not gathering leverage over the Road's enemies
Not sowing chaos among the Road's enemies
Not doing what it takes to convert the faithful of other gods
Refusing to help raise Set again

paths.name: Path of Apep
paths.house: The Virtues follow the Path's own creed of indulgence (as the Road of Sin), a house reading
sins: Passing up a chance to corrupt a mortal
Passing up a chance to corrupt a vampire
Passing up a chance to corrupt a holy person
Not undermining the mortal order around you
Putting another's wishes before your own

paths.name: Road of Angra Mainyu
paths.auraOn: +2 dice to persuade someone toward evil
paths.house: The Road of Zarathustra is two Roads. Every follower starts on this one, the Path of Apep's chart (V20 Dark Ages p. 449) with three rungs replaced, and may move once, free, to the Road of Ahura Mazda (usually from 5). Going back to Ahura Mazda later is a normal Road change (pp. 112-115)
sins: Passing up a chance to corrupt a mortal
Passing up a chance to corrupt a vampire
Passing up a chance to corrupt a holy person
Not undermining the mortal order around you
Putting another's wishes before your own

night.name: Road of Night
night.auraOn: rolls to draw out secrets or stir remorse
sins: Spending your nights on Cainite affairs
Feeling remorse for what you do
Killing a mortal who has not confessed
Bowing to a Cainite not of the Road or your clan
Killing a sinner except in self-defence
Trying to redeem a sinner without pain
Embracing a sinner who could still repent

paths.name: Path of Heavenly Abode
paths.house: The Storytellers Companion names this path without its own hierarchy; it walks the Road's, a house reading
